name: Promo · 3D city webinar
tagline: Bright glossy promo with a three.js 3D city fly-through, swipes, bursts and rays. For events and webinars.
recipe: A @remotion/three city scene with a scripted camera path (cam.ts); 2D overlays anchored to 3D points (Anchor).
Big gradient headlines with halo, Gloss buttons, Burst / Rays / Swipe / FlashW transitions, Seg sub-sequences.
Rendering needs the angle GL renderer (already in remotion.config.ts and the studio renderer).
